_csp_documentation.default-src 'none': Deny-by-default baseline; every resource type must be explicitly allowed.
_csp_documentation.script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval': 'self' for extension-bundled JS modules. 'wasm-unsafe-eval' for WebAssembly.instantiate (pap-wasm). No 'unsafe-eval' — Function() replaced with import(@vite-ignore).
_csp_documentation.style-src: 'self' for bundled CSS. External origins for @import in design-system.css: Satoshi (Fontshare), DM Sans + JetBrains Mono (Google Fonts).
_csp_documentation.font-src: 'self' + CDNs serving .woff2 files: api.fontshare.com (Satoshi), fonts.gstatic.com (DM Sans, JetBrains Mono).
_csp_documentation.img-src 'self': Only extension-bundled icons (icons/icon-*.png). No external images.
_csp_documentation.connect-src: 'self' for chrome.runtime. http://localhost + 127.0.0.1 for local dev agents. https://* for production agents (gated by optional_host_permissions). wss://* for WebSocket transport.
_csp_documentation.form-action 'none': No form submissions; all communication via fetch/WebSocket/chrome.runtime.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' https://api.fontshare.com https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://api.fontshare.com https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:* https://* wss://*; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none';
